cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 63% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX -0.47% · WTI -1.04% · Brent -4.19% · NatGas +4.61%. 63% of 67 energy names are green — a broad bid. Grid, Storage & Electrification is doing the heavy lifting at +1.80%.

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Refining & Downstream lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +1.80%; weakest is Refining & Downstream at -2.73%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: PWR is the standout at +6.09%
cards.body: Leaders: PWR +6.09%, LNG +6.06%, EOSE +4.36%, VRT +3.00%, BWXT +2.78%. Laggards: FTI -5.74%, MPC -4.63%, EQT -2.75%, NXE -2.63%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.
